entries.speaker: Using the Batting Cages
entries.en: Using the batting cages will cause time[n]to pass, but you can get prizes based on[n]your performance. Your [stIcon 2][clr 26][stLabel 2][clr 27][n]will also improve.

entries.speaker: Using the Batting Cages
entries.en: You will face a total of 5 pitches. Hitting[n]all five pitches will get you the [clr 2]slugger prize[clr 27].[n]If you hit a home run, you'll get the [clr 2]home run prize[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Using the Batting Cages
entries.en: Activities available change according to the time of[n]day. At night, there are no prizes, but you can [clr 2]swing[n]as much as you want[clr 27]. Also, if you hit [clr 2]3[clr 27] home runs,[n]you'll receive a coupon for a [clr 2]free daytime session[clr 27].
